You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To beat egg whites, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Check for any yellow yolk specks in the bowl (30 seconds)
Step 2. Set the mixer to medium speed (10 seconds)
Step 3. Observe the formation of soft peaks (2 minutes)
Step 4. Wipe down the mixer stand (1 minute)
Step 5. Take eggs out of the refrigerator (30 seconds)
Step 6. Select a large copper or glass bowl (45 seconds)
Step 7. Ensure the bowl is completely free of grease (2 minutes)
Step 8. Finish the meringue preparation (5 minutes)
Step 9. Separate the first egg over a small cup (20 seconds)
Step 10. Clear a workspace on the kitchen counter (3 minutes)
Step 11. Add a pinch of cream of tartar (10 seconds)
Step 12. Locate the balloon whisk attachment (1 minute)
Step 13. Pour the egg whites into the main mixing bowl (15 seconds)
Step 14. Add a teaspoon of vanilla extract (15 seconds)
Step 15. Wash your hands thoroughly (40 seconds)
Step 16. Stop the mixer to check consistency (10 seconds)
Step 17. Crack the second egg (15 seconds)
Step 18. Monitor the egg whites for a foamy appearance (1 minute)
Step 19. Separate the third egg (20 seconds)
Step 20. Prepare the sugar for gradual addition (2 minutes)
Step 21. Increase mixer speed to high (10 seconds)
Step 22. Add the first tablespoon of superfine sugar (15 seconds)
Step 23. Lower the whisk into the whites (5 seconds)
Step 24. Inspect the egg carton for cracks (30 seconds)
Step 25. Place the bowl onto the mixer base (20 seconds)
Step 26. Turn on the mixer to the lowest setting (5 seconds)
Step 27. Measure out the total sugar required (1 minute)
Step 28. Rinse the whisk under cold water (30 seconds)
Step 29. Attach the whisk to the mixer head (15 seconds)
Step 30. Crack the fourth egg (15 seconds)
Step 31. Dry the whisk with a lint-free towel (45 seconds)
Step 32. Ensure the mixer is plugged in (10 seconds)
Step 33. Lower the mixer head into position (5 seconds)
Step 34. Check the temperature of the whites (1 minute)
Step 35. Let the eggs sit to reach room temperature (30 minutes)
Step 36. Position the mixer away from the counter edge (15 seconds)
Step 37. Wait for the whites to lose their translucent look (2 minutes)
Step 38. Watch for the bubbles to become small and uniform (3 minutes)
Step 39. Crack the fifth egg (15 seconds)
Step 40. Separate the sixth egg (20 seconds)
Step 41. Wipe the rim of the bowl (20 seconds)
Step 42. Lock the mixer head (5 seconds)
Step 43. Add a tiny pinch of salt (10 seconds)
Step 44. Double check the recipe measurements (1 minute)
Step 45. Set a kitchen timer for the beating process (15 seconds)
Step 46. Begin beating the whites (30 seconds)
Step 47. Retrieve a clean spatula (30 seconds)
Step 48. Ensure the whisk is clicking into place (10 seconds)
Step 49. Check that the whisk clears the bottom of the bowl (20 seconds)
Step 50. Adjust the bowl height screw (1 minute)
Step 51. Separate the seventh egg (20 seconds)
Step 52. Read the specific recipe instructions for peaks (2 minutes)
Step 53. Align the whisk grooves (10 seconds)
Step 54. Inspect the bowl for dust (15 seconds)
Step 55. Let the whites sit for a moment to stabilize (1 minute)
Step 56. Transfer the whites from the small cup to a holding bowl (10 seconds)
Step 57. Crack the eighth egg (15 seconds)
Step 58. Retrieve the cream of tartar from the pantry (1 minute)
Step 59. Final check of the bowl contents (10 seconds)
Step 60. Separate the ninth egg (20 seconds)
Step 61. Slowly pour in more sugar (45 seconds)
Step 62. Get the measuring spoons ready (1 minute)
Step 63. Reach the stiff peak stage (3 minutes)
Step 64. Check for trail marks left by the whisk (1 minute)
Step 65. Clean the splash guard (1 minute)
Step 66. Crack the tenth egg (15 seconds)
Step 67. Separate the final egg (20 seconds)
Step 68. Verify no yolk broke into the batch (30 seconds)
Step 69. Observe the whites turning opaque white (2 minutes)
Step 70. Watch for the whites to become glossy (2 minutes)
Step 71. Put the egg yolks aside for another recipe (1 minute)
Step 72. Sanitize the mixing area (2 minutes)
Step 73. Add another tablespoon of sugar (15 seconds)
Step 74. Beat until the whites double in volume (4 minutes)
Step 75. Scrape down the sides of the bowl (30 seconds)
Step 76. Dispose of the eggshells (1 minute)
Step 77. Sift the sugar to remove lumps (2 minutes)
Step 78. Separate the eleventh egg (20 seconds)
Step 79. Allow the whites to settle (1 minute)
Step 80. Wipe the beaters with lemon juice (45 seconds)
Step 81. Add the final portion of sugar (15 seconds)
Step 82. Retrieve the lemon juice from the fridge (1 minute)
Step 83. Organize the ingredients on the counter (2 minutes)
Step 84. Check the humidity of the kitchen (1 minute)
Step 85. Wipe the mixing bowl with a paper towel (20 seconds)
Step 86. Test the peaks by lifting the whisk (10 seconds)
Step 87. Separate the twelfth egg (20 seconds)
Step 88. Check the speed settings on the mixer (15 seconds)
Step 89. Clear the sink of dirty dishes (5 minutes)
Step 90. Find the sugar container (1 minute)
Step 91. Achieve a satiny sheen on the mixture (2 minutes)
Step 92. Ensure no liquid remains at the bottom (1 minute)
Step 93. Beat for one final minute on high (1 minute)
Step 94. Measure the cream of tartar (30 seconds)
Step 95. Open the sugar bag (20 seconds)
Step 96. Gather all necessary eggs from the carton (30 seconds)
Step 97. Add the remaining flavorings (15 seconds)
Step 98. Check the power cord for safety (30 seconds)
Step 99. Monitor the transformation from liquid to foam (2 minutes)
Step 100. Inspect the whisk wires for damage (30 seconds)
